questions.q: What did Solomon begin to build in the fourth year of his reign?
questions.evidence: he began to build Yahweh’s house

questions.q: What did Solomon ask God to give him at Gibeon?
questions.evidence: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil

questions.q: When two women claimed the same child, what did Solomon order?
options: Give the child to the elder
Divide the living child in two
questions.evidence: The king said, “Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other
answerTerms: Divide the living child in two

questions.q: What turned Solomon's heart away when he was old?
questions.evidence: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods

questions.q: Which queen came to test Solomon with hard questions?
questions.evidence: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning Yahweh’s name, she came to test him with hard questions

questions.q: Whose counsel did Rehoboam follow when Israel asked for a lighter yoke?
questions.evidence: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him

questions.q: What brought Elijah bread and meat by the brook?
questions.evidence: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening

questions.q: On Mount Carmel, what fell and consumed Elijah's offering?
questions.evidence: Then Yahweh’s fire fell, and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench

questions.q: After the wind, the earthquake and the fire, what came to Elijah?
questions.evidence: After the fire, there was a still small voice
